enable_session_view.name: Enable Session Details
enable_session_view.hint: Expose session_view to the AI. Turning this off hides the tool and its instructions and blocks calls to it.

zh.name: 启用会话详情工具
zh.hint: 向 AI 提供 session_view。关闭后隐藏该工具及其使用说明，并禁止调用。

enable_get_message_history.name: Enable Message History
enable_get_message_history.hint: Expose get_message_history to the AI. Turning this off hides the tool and its instructions and blocks calls to it; stored history is not deleted.

zh.name: 启用历史消息工具
zh.hint: 向 AI 提供 get_message_history。关闭后隐藏该工具及其使用说明，并禁止调用；不会删除已有历史存档。

cross_session_read.name: Cross-session Reading
cross_session_read.hint: Controls which calling sessions may read other sessions through session_view and get_message_history. When the tool is enabled, reading the current session does not require cross-session authorization. Target sessions must also be allowed by their adapter.

zh.name: 跨会话读取
zh.hint: 控制哪些来源会话可以通过 session_view 和 get_message_history 读取其他会话。工具启用时读取当前会话无需跨会话授权，目标会话还必须满足其适配器的访问规则。

permission_mode.name: Caller Permission Mode
permission_mode.hint: allow_list permits only listed calling sessions; deny_list permits all except listed calling sessions. The default empty allow list disables cross-session reading.

zh.name: 来源会话权限模式
zh.hint: allow_list：仅名单内的来源会话可以跨会话读取；deny_list：除名单内的来源会话外均可读取。默认空白名单禁止跨会话读取。

session_list.name: Calling Sessions
session_list.hint: Full routing IDs of calling sessions, for example my-adapter:dm:123. These are the sessions requesting access, not the target sessions being read.

zh.name: 来源会话名单
zh.hint: 填写发起读取的来源会话完整标识，例如 my-adapter:dm:123。这里是请求访问的会话，不是被读取的目标会话。
